# How much of my salary do I take home in Scotland?

> Free Scottish income tax calculator for 2026/27: the six Scottish bands (19% to 48%), National Insurance, student loan and pension, with monthly and weekly take-home pay and a comparison with the rest of the UK. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
